reply_text:
@Tobias, the depot is **Southgate**. In the Sept 3, 2025 entries in this channel, Priyanka wrote that label printing stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. Later that day she posted that Southgate had cleared the backlog and labels were printing again.

Those entries are from September 2025, so check that this is the outage your customer call is about before you rely on it.
